title: Have a health and safety management system for the mine
what: As the mine operator, develop, implement, maintain and review a health and safety management system that suits the mine's size, operations and risks.

laws.title: Mines Work Health and Safety (Supplementary Requirements) Act 2012 (Tas)

sources.title: Mines Work Health and Safety (Supplementary Requirements) Act 2012 (Tas)
sources.quote: A mine operator must develop, implement, maintain and review a health and safety management system for the mine that is both effective for and commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the mine and mining operations, and the associated risks
